Build the card table for a deck specification

Source: R/deck.R
mm_build_deck.Rd

Expands an mm_deck_spec() into one row per physical card. This is the table the engine deals from.

Usage

mm_build_deck(spec = mm_deck_spec(), call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

spec

A deck specification from mm_deck_spec().

call

The environment used for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A tibble::tibble() with spec$size rows and columns

color

Card colour (character); NA for wild cards.

value

Number face (integer); NA for +2, skip, and wild.

type

One of "number", "plus2", "skip", "wild" (character).

An empty specification yields a 0-row tibble with those columns, never NULL.

See also

mm_deck_spec() for the composition itself.

Other deck: mm_deck_spec()

Examples

deck <- mm_build_deck()
deck
#> # A tibble: 32 × 3
#>    color value type  
#>    <chr> <int> <chr> 
#>  1 red       1 number
#>  2 red       2 number
#>  3 red       3 number
#>  4 red       4 number
#>  5 red       5 number
#>  6 green     1 number
#>  7 green     2 number
#>  8 green     3 number
#>  9 green     4 number
#> 10 green     5 number
#> # ℹ 22 more rows
table(deck$type)
#> 
#> number  plus2   skip   wild 
#>     20      4      4      4
